evidence.description: Direct access to a singleton service via .shared

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the 'EcosiaAuthUIStateProvider' service through its '.shared' property, creating a hard-coded singleton dependency instead of using an explicit dependency injection mechanism.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Global static variable 'shared' with mutable state and no isolation

candidates.explanation: The 'User.shared' property is a global static variable that is modified (via 'didSet' and 'save()') and accessed across different contexts without any visible actor isolation or synchronization mechanism.
candidates.title: Unprotected Mutable Global or Static State

evidence.description: Unprotected concurrent write to shared state via a background queue

candidates.explanation: The 'save()' method captures 'self' (the 'User' instance) and executes a write operation on a background queue ('User.queue.async') without any synchronization or actor isolation to protect the mutable state of the 'User' instance.
candidates.title: Improper Isolation of Shared Mutable State

evidence.description: Force unwrap of a date calculation result

candidates.explanation: The code uses a force unwrap ('!') on the result of 'Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -3, to: .init())' without establishing a guarantee that the date calculation will succeed.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
